config.role: Gemma, EXPLORATORY passive-only depth curve (passive test only; not run through the rest of the chain)
config.declared: 2026-11-10, before any evaluation at this site
config.site_rule: user request 2026-11-10: passive test at every not-yet-run site from 0 to ~60% depth (Gemma 0-15)
config.epoch_rule: the frozen rule applied to this site's sweep curve: smallest epoch whose mean held-out cross-class IIA is within 0.01 of the site's best (sweep_strict/sweep.csv)
config.rule:
- For each site take its best epoch by mean held-out cross-class IIA (folds
  pooled). Late sites control the readout almost linearly, so the highest
  IIA alone would favour them; the rule instead takes the **earliest** site
  whose best IIA is within 0.02 of the overall best and whose median
  positive-control fraction at that epoch is >= 0.5.
- Epochs: the smallest epoch at that site whose IIA is within 0.01 of the
  site's best.
Rank is chosen later, in `run_das_round2.py final`, by its own rule.
